comparison.objective: Spot a lifter through bench presses and intervene only on a stalled repetition; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Monitor motion, time a physical catch and assist a moving bar to lockout versus fine mechanical adjustment and guarded test operation.
comparison.success_condition: No premature interference; stalled bar caught before the chest and raised to lockout versus two safe repeatable carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Reactive human-safety intervention tests contact timing and assistance, not adjustment and validation of a mechanical energy absorber.
